title: Drumming approach: steady beat, left foot, cymbal and press roll
summary: The drummer's role is steady time; bass drum falls on the left foot in a march, cymbal half-beat, and his crushed roll done with the fingers.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Well, what do you think the role of the drumming in the band is? I mean, what do you try to do to help the band when you drum?

Well, when I'm drumming like that, see what I do if a drummer like that, if you don't know, I'll try to talk to them, you know. And I'll take one stick, you know, like that, and try to show them when they hit. But some people come and try, they don't want to tell them nothing.
Well, what I'm trying to say is, what are you trying to do when you're drumming? You trying to keep a steady beat?

Oh, yeah, yeah, steady beat, yeah. Study beat. This is when the drummer beat my alarm, you mean? Yeah, either way. Well, you see, yeah, steady beat. Now, you see, you see your drumming, you see the drummer, that's the time in the band. You can take a drummer there, you fall down, you pick up, you throw everything out of time. But when you're playing drummer, like I play with a band like that, you got to have a steady time. You see, like you're playing a pune like that. You take a bass drummer like he didn't know how to tell him if I ain't playing bass drum. You always knock off on your left foot. One, two, three, four.

No, just like you hit on the left foot, boom. You like playing a few of them. You know, boom. You don't hit that cymbal. You see, when you're playing a few, you don't use that cymbal at all. Yeah, it's up and down. Yeah. It's half the beat on your cymbal all the time. Half the beat on the cymbal. On the cymbal all the time, yeah. I noticed about your role, too. You have quite a distinctive role.
Yeah, well I have all kind of role. Well, I studied all that, you know. Yeah. A lot of, now the important thing is that crushed roll I make. Plenty of people can't make that.
Well, what is that exactly, crushed roll?

It just started like that. Just throw the stick into your... That's all. Actually, you don't understand. Don't move your wrist. Just your fingers, that's all. Excuse your fingers. You ever notice, yeah, I don't move my wrist. Yeah.
Yeah. Yeah. People can't get that.

Yeah. Yeah. Right, you think. Some people call that a press roll. Yeah, because I'm all calling it a press roll. But in the book, it's a crushed roll. Press roll. Yeah. In the book, it's a crushed roll. Yeah. A lot of people call it a press roll.
